sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Teams WHERE year = 2006 AND W > L AND Pts > 100
SELECT name FROM Teams WHERE year = 1995 AND name IN ('Florida Panthers', 'Edmonton Oilers', 'Los Angeles Kings') ORDER BY CAST(PKC AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T2.W FROM Teams AS T1 INNER JOIN TeamVsTeam AS T2 ON T1.year = T2.year AND T1.tmID = T2.tmID WHERE T1.name = 'Philadelphia Flyers' AND T2.oppID = 'BOS' AND T1.year = 1985

SELECT T3.name FROM Teams AS T1 INNER JOIN TeamVsTeam AS T2 ON T1.year = T2.year AND T1.tmID = T2.oppID INNER JOIN Teams AS T3 ON T2.year = T3.year AND T2.tmID = T3.tmID WHERE T1.name = 'Buffalo Sabres' AND T1.year = 2000 GROUP BY T3.name ORDER BY SUM(T2.W + T2.L + COALESCE(T2.T, 0)) DESC, T3.name LIMIT 1
SELECT T2.PIM FROM Teams AS T1 INNER JOIN TeamsSC AS T2 ON T1.year = T2.year AND T1.tmID = T2.tmID WHERE T1.name = 'Montreal Canadiens' AND T1.year = 1918
SELECT T1.W FROM Teams AS T1 INNER JOIN TeamsSC AS T2 ON T1.year = T2.year AND T1.tmID = T2.tmID WHERE T1.name = 'Montreal Canadiens' AND T2.PIM = '24'
SELECT AVG(CAST(T2.W AS REAL) / T2.G) FROM Teams AS T1 INNER JOIN TeamsSC AS T2 ON T1.year = T2.year AND T1.tmID = T2.tmID WHERE T1.name = 'Montreal Canadiens'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T3.birthCountry = 'USA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.coachID) FROM Coaches AS T1 INNER JOIN Teams AS T2 ON T1.year = T2.year AND T1.tmID = T2.tmID INNER JOIN Master AS T3 ON T1.coachID = T3.coachID WHERE T2.name = 'Montreal Canadiens'
SELECT COUNT(playerID) FROM Master WHERE lastName = 'Green' AND playerID IS NOT NULL AND coachID IS NULL
SELECT T2.firstName, T2.lastName FROM Goalies AS T1 INNER JOIN Master AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.ENG = '10' ORDER BY CAST(T2.height AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.tmID) FROM Goalies AS T1 INNER JOIN Master AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.lastName = 'Young'

SELECT DISTINCT T2.firstName, T2.lastName FROM Goalies AS T1 INNER JOIN Master AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.tmID = 'BOS' AND T1.year = 1972 AND T2.coachID IS NOT NULL AND T2.hofID IS NULL

SELECT T2.firstName, T2.lastName FROM Goalies AS T1 INNER JOIN Master AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID INNER JOIN Teams AS T3 ON T1.year = T3.year AND T1.tmID = T3.tmID WHERE T3.name = 'Minnesota North Stars' GROUP BY T1.playerID ORDER BY SUM(CAST(T1.GA AS INTEGER)) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.year = 2005 THEN CAST(T1.GP AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T1.year = 2006 THEN CAST(T1.GP AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN T1.year = 2005 THEN CAST(T1.GP AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END) FROM Goalies AS T1 INNER JOIN Master AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.firstName = 'David' AND T2.lastName = 'Aebischer'
SELECT playerID FROM Master WHERE playerID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY playerID HAVING AVG(height) = 75
SELECT playerID FROM Master WHERE playerID IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CAST(weight AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT playerID FROM Master WHERE deathYear IS NOT NULL AND playerID IS NOT NULL
SELECT DISTINCT T1.coachID FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN AwardsCoaches AS T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID WHERE T1.playerID IS NULL AND T1.coachID IS NOT NULL
SELECT SUM(T1.Pts), T2.coachID FROM Teams AS T1 INNER JOIN Coaches AS T2 ON T1.year = T2.year AND T1.tmID = T2.tmID WHERE T1.tmID = 'ANA' GROUP BY T2.coachID

SELECT DISTINCT M.playerID, S.tmID FROM Master AS M INNER JOIN Scoring AS S ON M.playerID = S.playerID WHERE S.year BETWEEN 1925 AND 1936 AND M.playerID = (SELECT playerID FROM Master WHERE height IS NOT NULL AND playerID IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CAST(height AS INTEGER) ASC LIMIT 1)
SELECT CAST(T1.W AS REAL) / T1.G, (SELECT S.playerID FROM Scoring AS S WHERE S.year = 1998 AND S.tmID = 'CAR' ORDER BY S.G DESC LIMIT 1) FROM Teams AS T1 WHERE T1.year = 1998 AND T1.tmID = 'CAR'
